mechanism_name: NPoS with BABE block production and GRANDPA finality

evidence.label: Polkadot proof of stake consensus
evidence.claim: Polkadot uses Nominated Proof of Stake with BABE for block production and GRANDPA for deterministic finality.

evidence.label: Polkadot validator key management
evidence.claim: Validators use protocol session keys for consensus roles including BABE and GRANDPA.
